decisions.decision: Committee agreed by consensus to hold weekly mini meetings.
Members will send discussion items to Mrs. Benson to add to the agenda.
decisions.quote: members will send needed discussion items to mrs. benson to add to the agenda.

decisions.decision: Meeting time set at 4:30 P.M. at the Ritter Planning Board conference room.
decisions.quote: meeting time will be 4:30 p.m. at the ritter planning board conference room.

decisions.decision: An Evaluation Committee for the solar grant bid was assigned: Steve Marsden, Pat Slattery, Lisa Krowitz and Steve DiCampo, with Marion Benson as advisory member.
decisions.quote: an evaluation committee was assigned. members are steve marsden, pat slattery, lisa krowitz, and steve dicampo.

decisions.decision: Chair tasked David Blatt and Ernie Sund with researching wind energy fields.
decisions.quote: chair tasked david blatt and ernie sund to research wind energy fields.

decisions.decision: Directions based on consensus were given to Mr. Zivojinovic on the educational website's goals, content and design.
decisions.quote: directions based on consensus were given to mr. zivojinovic.

decisions.decision: Access to the educational website was limited to Derek Dufresne, Mr. Zivojinovic and his wife Deb, Ms. Krowitz and Planning Office clerk Lynne Klaft; Joanne McQuaid was given access on request.
decisions.quote: access to site was limited to: derek dufresne, mr. zivojinovic and his wife deb, ms. krowitz and planning office clerk lynne klaft.

decisions.decision: Committee will research an alternative to the Stretch Code.
decisions.quote: it was noted that there is an alterative that the committee will research.

decisions.decision: Bid for the solar roof panels to be opened at Town Hall on November 24, 2009, with a meeting at the Ritter at 4:00 P.M. to follow.
decisions.quote: bid will be opened at town hall at 2:00 p.m. on november 24, 2009.

decisions.decision: Meetings scheduled for December 1, 2009 (to decide interview invitations) and December 3, 2009 (interviews at 5:00, 6:00 and 7:00 P.M.), both at 4:30 P.M. at the Ritter.
decisions.quote: meeting will be held on december 1, 2009 at 4:30 p.m. at the ritter to decide interview invitations from the bid results.

decisions.decision: Next meeting set for Tuesday, October 20, 2009 at 4:30 P.M. at the Ritter Memorial Building, Planning Board conference room.
